mapper.select: SELECT send.sendid, send.text, send.title, send.message, send.reserved, DATE_FORMAT(send.senddate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') senddate FROM ttokssaemdb.webhooksendmsg send WHERE send.reserved = 'I'

SELECT send.sendid, send.text, send.title, send.message, send.reserved, DATE_FORMAT(send.senddate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') senddate FROM ttokssaemdb.webhooksendmsg send WHERE send.reserved = 'R' AND send.senddate <= now()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ttokssaemdb.webhooksentmsg ( sendid, text, title, message, reserved, senddate, response ) VALUES ( ${sendid}, #{text}, #{title}, #{message}, #{reserved}, STR_TO_DATE(#{senddate},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), #{response} )
